text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Official says Arab states are expected to set up privatisation programmes as part of overall reforms to help tackle their economic problems.
- Bahrain plans amendments to commercial agencies law to protect consumers.
- Four-member Gulf Arab mediation committee to hold its second meeting in Riyadh on Sunday to review Qatar's territorial dispute with Bahrain.
- Securities and Investment Co seeks to promote commercial activities in Bahrain.
